style: Theatrical vaudeville folk-rock band with lounge exotica and doo-wop pop. [HARMONY SYSTEM] Barbershop voice leading with ringing dominant tension, quartal cluster rubs, and parallel triads moving as a single block. [MELODIC SYSTEM] Fast cabaret patter, downward yodel register flips, chromatic ornaments, and clipped consonant attacks. [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] Swinging triplets invading a frantic waltz pulse, stop-start pauses, metric compression, and sharp silences. [TIMBRE SYSTEM] Upright bass, brushed snare, barrelhouse piano, banjo, bowed saw, and cheap parlor organ with room bleed. [PERFORMANCE] Theatrical overstatement delivered with deadpan administrative precision. [INVARIANT] A rhythmic clockwork ticking underneath all mutations. [OPERATORS] Hold the tempo fixed while meters warp; compress the vocal range while stretching the instrumental space; make the bass behave like a calendar; preserve the harmonic anchor while destabilizing the rhythmic grid; force bureaucratic narration to coexist with manic vaudeville energy.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Tempo: Frantic Waltz]
[Spoken Administrative Delivery]
Section Four point Two is heavy in the glass.
Verify the tesseract has finished half its mass.
We logged the geometry at zero-eight-hundred hours,
It's drinking down the angles and the architectural flowers.
[Sung Barbershop Harmony]
Oh, the corners are melting, the volume is dry,
A parallelogram wobbles and lets out a sigh!
[Spoken]
Bring the filing cabinets closer to the sink,
The geometry is staggering and starting to drink.

[Chorus]
[Swinging Triplet Rhythm]
[Tight Doo-Wop Vocals]
Bottoms up, hyper-cube! Bottoms up, plane!
You're spilling your dimensions all over the train!
The Euclidean cider is potent and neat,
It's flooding the station and drowning the street!
[Yodel Register Flip]
(Yodel-ay-hee-hoo!)
Pour another meridian into the cup,
The tesseract is drinking and it will not dry up!

[Verse 2]
[Metric Compression]
[Deadpan Spoken Recitative]
Incident Report Number Nine-B:
The tetrahedron is sitting under a tree,
Complaining of vertigo, slurring its lines,
Tracing non-Euclidean alcoholic signs.
We offered a napkin, we offered a scale,
It swallowed the compass, the anchor, the bail.
[Scat Vocals with Hard Consonants]
Bop-shoo-be-doo, the vertex is blurred!
Every single coordinate is completely absurd!
[Spoken]
Check the ledger for leakage in quadrant four,
The rhombus is vomiting right by the door.

[Bridge]
[Balkan 7/8 Asymmetric Pulse Interruption]
[Hocketed Vocal Fragments]
Drink it down! (Down!)
Swallow the town! (Town!)
The hyper-volume is legally blotto,
Exceeding the bounds of the municipal grotto!
[Barrelhouse Piano Solo with Bowed Saw Glissando]
[Administrative Narration over Fast Patter]
Regulation six requires all tipsy shapes
To be corked securely like fermented grapes.
Instead it is chanting, it's raising a glass,
Dissolving the borders of mass and class.

[Chorus]
[Return to Waltz Pulse]
[Massed Doo-Wop Harmony]
Bottoms up, hyper-cube! Bottoms up, plane!
You're spilling your dimensions all over the train!
The Euclidean cider is potent and neat,
It's flooding the station and drowning the street!
[Yodel Register Flip]
(Yodel-ay-hee-hoo!)
Pour another meridian into the cup,
The tesseract is drinking and it will not dry up!

[Verse 3]
[Lossy Reconstruction / Artifact Syntax]
[Whispered Ensemble Rhythm]
Compressed signal... shape loss... artifact bloom...
The liquor has leaked into every spare room.
[Sung in High Falsetto]
A square is a circle, a line is a bowl,
The tesseract drank the whole universe whole!
[Spoken Clerical Voice]
We cannot audit a shape that is looped,
It staggered around and the coordinates drooped.

[Outro]
[Stop-Start Metric Slams]
[Deadpan Speech-Song]
File the paperwork under 'Intoxicated Space'.
Wipe the spilled dimensions from the administration's face.
The glass is empty.
The angles are dry.
[Final Yodel Register Drop and Sudden Silence]
Goodnight, geometry. Goodnight, pi.
caption: A theatrical vaudeville folk-rock collision where a mathematically inebriated tesseract staggers through bureaucratic oversight. Powered by barbershop vocal harmonization, manic cabaret patter, swinging waltzes, and deadpan administrative narration treating impossible spatial intoxication as routine office paperwork.
